title: Doct. 4. We must not affect singularity of dispensations, but be content to be dealt with as others of Gods Children have been dealt with before us.

segments.text: We must not expect to go to Heaven without difficulties, 1 Pet. 5. 9. Knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your Brethren that are in the world. We are not alone, our Lot is no harder than others of Gods holy ones. All have gone to Heaven this way. God will so manifest himself to us, that still there may be room for faith and patience.
